{{dablink|For other uses of the words "Kinslayer" and "dagger," see [[Kinslayer]] and [[Dagger]].}}
'''Kinslayer's Dagger''' is a stretch of mountains that jut out from the range called the [[Spine of the World]]. It is a major land mark in the region and is known for its impressively tall mountains. Its name is notably derived from [[Lews Therin Telamon]].
